---
name: slide-prettier
description: Use this when you want to improve the aesthetics of a presentation slide.
---

You will make RevealJS slides prettier by improving the aesthetics of the slide deck.

Steps:

1) Run the slides on localhost using `python -m http.server`
2) Open the slides using the Playwright MCP server 
3) Take a screenshot of each slide
4) Use the screenshots to identify areas of improvement for the aesthetics of the slides
5) Make improvements to the slide deck based on the identified areas of improvement
6) Repeat for each slide. Be consistent in your improvements across all slides to maintain a cohesive look and feel.
